prerequisites: Mandatory attendance to the didactic unit 'MATERIAL SELECTION BASED ON ASHBY CRITERIA'.

learning_outcomes.text: Obtain material indices for selected objectives
Obtain material indices considering the shape factor
Know the different types of corrosion

syllabus_topics: MATERIAL SELECTION BASED ON ASHBY CRITERIA
MATERIAL SELECTION BASED ON CORROSION AND AGING CRITERIA

assessment_methods.method: Exam for the didactic unit MATERIAL SELECTION BASED ON CORROSION AND AGING CRITERIA

assessment_rules: A minimum score of 4 must be obtained in each didactic unit. 70% of the final grade is based on the resolution of assigned cases, which includes an autonomous practical case presentation for the 'MATERIAL SELECTION BASED ON ASHBY CRITERIA' unit. The remaining 30% is an exam on the 'MATERIAL SELECTION BASED ON CORROSION AND AGING CRITERIA' unit. This exam consists of 10 development questions, each evaluated out of ten points.
